reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a speech bubble containing bulleted lines crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing disabling comments, muting chat, or hiding speaker notes. While specific, it genuinely fits real tasks around muting noisy group chats, turning off blog/video comments, or stripping annotations before sharing files. At tiny sizes it can be confused with a crossed-out subtitles box or generic chat-off icon.

pass1.ambiguity: At small sizes, the internal dots and lines can blur together with the slash, making it look like a generic crossed-out document, credit card, or subtitles-off icon.
